body:
I'll start by reading the translation guide and my assigned files.

Now writing the English rewrites. Starting with 04 and 05.

All six files rewritten in English. Verification done: `## Sources` is last in each, no `fonte:`/`Fontes`/`derivado:` remnants, code fences balanced (04: 8, 05: 2, 07: 4, 17: 0, 18: 2, 19: 0 — 17/19 have no fenced blocks), URL sets match the originals one-for-one, and `git show HEAD` confirmed only my six files were touched (they are untracked, so no diff noise elsewhere).

| File | Bytes |
|---|---|
| 04-instalacao-e-topologias.md | 8721 |
| 05-configuracao-profunda.md | 9028 |
| 07-seguranca-auth-e-permissoes.md | 9218 |
| 17-operacao-e-saude.md | 9042 |
| 18-performance-e-capacidade.md | 7880 |
| 19-backup-restore-e-upgrade.md | 9063 |

Preserved exactly: every `path:line` citation and docs URL (including the one I briefly mangled and restored: `server-installation/from-zip-file/starting-stopping-server/running-as-a-service.md` in 19); all property names, defaults, env vars, UI labels (`Administration > Security > Users`, `Administration > System > Download logs`, …), edition markers, tables and code blocks (docker run, Helm YAML, systemd unit, properties, LDAP block, curl, DB maintenance SQL, telemetry/JMX flags); the JDBC divergence note in both 05 §3 and 18 §3 (code defaults `maxActive=60`, `minIdle=10`, `maxWait=8000` vs docs `minIdle=2`, `maxIdle=5`, `maxWait=5000`) and the `sonar.jdbc.maxIdle` deprecation with its `DefaultDatabase.java:71-74` citation; the unverified UI-vs-properties precedence caveat; `<home>/data/es9` and `<nome>` placeholders left untouched inside commands.

Compressed away (wording only, no facts): repeated lead-ins such as "In this section", per-file repeated explanations of `javaOpts` vs `javaAdditionalOpts` (stated once per file, then referenced), the "pequeno/grande" prose forms (kept as "Small"/"large" with identical numbers), and 04's table cells `idem` → `same`. 19's "EDR" disambiguation and 18's housekeeping/EDR caveat were kept verbatim in meaning.

Byte target note: files land 7.9–9.2 KB, not ≤7 KB. The unshrinkable payload — 5–12 full docs URLs (1.2–1.8 KB) plus the `repo ae3d6eb:` path lists and mirrored inline citations — is 2.7–3.0 KB per file, and the mandated tables/code blocks add another 1.5–2 KB; reaching 7 KB would have required deleting facts or de-duplicating citations, both excluded by the contract. 18 is the only file I could push near the floor (7880). I did not run any build/lint/test.
